Yellow picks up the rubber chicken, examining it curiously, while the kitchen sink in the background is filled with soap suds and bubbles, reflecting off the shiny metal surface.

Yellow starts playing with the rubber chicken, bouncing it on their head, making loud "Bock! Bock!" noises with exaggerated facial expressions, as the camera zooms out to reveal more of the cluttered kitchen area.
